description: Scheduler / SOS worker pressure: KPI, fleet trends, hot scheduler tables, and CPU topology. Collector: mssql_scheduler (30s).

panels.description: Sum of runnable tasks across all visible online schedulers on selected servers.
panels.title: Total Runnable

panels.description: Worker starvation signal - tasks waiting for a worker thread.
panels.title: Total Work Queue

panels.description: Schedulers with runnable >= min threshold AND above instance average x Over Avg factor.

targets.expr: count((mssql_scheduler_runnable_tasks{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", scheduler_id=~"${scheduler_id:regex}"} >= $min_runnable and on(instance) (mssql_scheduler_runnable_tasks{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", scheduler_id=~"${scheduler_id:regex}"} >= $min_runnable > (avg by (instance) (mssql_scheduler_runnable_tasks{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}"}) * $over_avg_factor)))) or vector(0)

targets.expr: max by (instance, scheduler_id, cpu_id) (mssql_scheduler_runnable_tasks{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", scheduler_id=~"${scheduler_id:regex}"} >= $min_runnable)

max by (instance, scheduler_id, cpu_id) (mssql_scheduler_active_workers{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", scheduler_id=~"${scheduler_id:regex}"})
